tools.sr-rechner-desc: Calculate additions of Süßreserve, concentrate or sulphured must.

tools.sr-verschnitt-desc: Blending calculation using mixing rules for sweeteners.

errors.invalid: Error! Please enter a numerical value.
errors.range: Target must be between wine and sugar

sr-rechner.title: Dosage Master %
sr-rechner.subtitle: High-precision calculation of component additions
sr-rechner.seo-description: Professional calculation of sugar, concentrate or must dosage to achieve the target.
sr-rechner.auf-desc: Addition calculated from base wine volume.
sr-rechner.in-desc: Sweetener proportion in the finished blend (total volume).
sr-rechner.formula-in: Proportion in the final blend volume.

sr-verschnitt.title: Sweetener Blending
sr-verschnitt.subtitle: Achieving the desired sweetness
sr-verschnitt.seo-description: Calculate the perfect blend between wine and sweet reserve using mixing rules.
sr-verschnitt.formula-usage: Determination of the required sugar volume

alkohol.title: Enological Converter
alkohol.subtitle: High-precision calculation by G. Troost
alkohol.seo-description: Professional tool for analyzing must and wine parameters.
alkohol.formula-desc: High-precision calculation based on G. Troost table (1980)

mehrfach.title: Multiple Blending
mehrfach.subtitle: Calculation of sugar and alcohol for any number of wine batches
mehrfach.seo-description: Optimize your wine blends with weighted average calculations for sugar and alcohol across multiple batches.
mehrfach.formula-desc: Calculation of final sugar and alcohol parameters
mehrfach.formula-logic-desc: Total mass divided by total volume of all batches.

so2-calc.title: SO2 Calculator
so2-calc.subtitle: Calculation of required SO2 amount for sulfitation
so2-calc.seo-description: Calculate sulfur (SO2) additions using gas, potassium metabisulfite powder, or liquid solutions.

acid-management.title: Acid Management
acid-management.subtitle: Calculate additions for acidification or deacidification
acid-management.seo-description: Calculate precise additions of tartaric, malic, or lactic acid for wine balance.
acid-management.alert-trial: Always perform a bench trial first. Wine chemistry can be unpredictable.
acid-management.warn-tartaric: Risk of tartrate crystals! Do not bottle for 6 weeks after addition.
acid-management.warn-citric: Limit: max 1 g/L. Risk of volatile acidity if added before MLF.

chaptalization.title: Chaptalization
chaptalization.subtitle: Increase potential alcohol
chaptalization.seo-description: Calculate sugar addition to increase wine alcohol based on Troost standards.
chaptalization.formula-desc-1: The calculation of the required sugar per liter is based on the difference in sugar values between the target and current must, taken from the Troost table.
chaptalization.formula-desc-2: The volume increase is calculated based on the fact that 1 kg of sugar increases the volume by 0.63 liters.
chaptalization.error-target: Target value must be higher than current

disclaimer.title: Limitation of Liability
disclaimer.content: All calculations provided by the VinoFlow application are based on generally accepted oenological formulas and standards (including G. Troost tables). However, these results are theoretical. Winemaking is a complex biological process influenced by hundreds of factors. The developer is not liable for any direct or indirect damages, including spoilage of wine material, financial losses, or product non-compliance with legal standards, resulting from the use of this application. Final technological decisions must be made by a qualified specialist based on laboratory analysis.

external.title: External Links
external.content: The application may contain links to third-party resources. We do not control and are not responsible for the content or privacy policies of these sites.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: We use minimal cookies for application stability. We do not collect personal data or use ad targeting.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Your privacy is our priority. VinoFlow does not collect personal data. There are no user accounts and no cloud storage for your calculations. All data is stored locally on your device (LocalStorage). We have no access to your winemaking data.

Impressum.title: Legal Disclosure
Impressum.subtitle: Official information about the resource owner
